title: Military aircrew in 'stable condition' following midair collision at Idaho air show
summary: Two jets appeared to collide and their crews ejected during a performance at an air show at a military base in Idaho. "The aircrew involved in the incident are in stable condition," the base reported.
contentText:
Two jets appeared to collide and their crews ejected during a performance at an air show at a military base in Idaho. "The aircrew involved in the incident are in stable condition," the base reported.

(Image credit: Senior Airman Xavier Wilson)
